parsed.note_claim: The regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone, while politicians like Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train that was stopped nearby as a precaution.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In der Grenzregion Wolyn hat zudem eine Drohne die Lokomotive eines Personenzugs zwei Kilometer vor der polnischen Grenze angegriffen... Der Bahnbetreiber PKP Intercity teilte mit, der Zug sei von Kiew nach Warschau unterwegs gewesen.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone, and separately reports that Sautter and Johnson were on a privately chartered train that was stopped near the Polish border and partially evacuated due to drones.
